explanation: Matches Theorem 1.1 parts (1) and the first half of (2) of arXiv:2607.05739: if x_n=m then K_n∣(1+m²), and if K_n>1 then |m|≥√(K_n-1). kernel is definition (3), the product of primes dividing ω_n to odd order. The growth estimate log|m|≥(1/2+o(1))n log n is not included, but the docstring does not claim it. The A_n≠0 hypothesis is harmless, because it always holds.
